hooks.logic:
Let v be unset.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
For each x with key k in list
  If x's 'paramSuffixNo' is the enemy → get-suffix-no-by-param-id with (the enemy → get-current-param-id), then set v to k.
Let hpRate2 be the phase for the enemy under the phases list with HP fraction hpRate from phase v.
If v is not hpRate2, then
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form list at hpRate2's 'paramSuffixNo' on the enemy.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If not the register's 'hasUsedYellowCherry' and hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_yellow_cherry" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then
  Let ability be the id of the move labelled "energy_100" on the enemy.
  Set the register's 'hasUsedYellowCherry' to true.
  The enemy uses the move labelled "yellow_cherry" immediately.
  Call game:ai.AiUtil.registerInterruptMultipleAbility with (the enemy, ability, [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "01"}]]}}]).
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability2 be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If ability2 is the id of the move labelled "jump" on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability2 with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}, {abilityId: ability2, abilityOptions: {shouldDeformAllNodes: true}}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}], [{builtin: "ENABLE_AND_UPDATE_POS_ARRAY", visible: {visibleNo: [1]}}]]}}].
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability2.
